#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Brute-force which printable chars are allowed inside a highlighted span.

Usage: chars.py '<template with %c>' '<sed-ish marker regex not needed>'
It runs ./executable with given args, feeds template with each char,
and reports chars where the whole 'a<c>b' appears INSIDE the target span.
The target span is identified by the style code prefix given.
"""
import subprocess, sys, re

template = sys.argv[1]
args = sys.argv[2:-1]
style = sys.argv[-1].encode()  # e.g. b'\x1b[32m'

ESC = b'\x1b[0m'
allowed, stopped = [], []
for i in range(33, 127):
    c = chr(i)
    line = template.replace('%c', c)
    out = subprocess.run(['./executable'] + args, input=line.encode(),
                         capture_output=True).stdout
    # find span: style + content + ESC
    m = re.search(re.escape(style) + rb'(.*?)' + re.escape(ESC), out)
    if m and m.group(1) == ('a%sb' % c).encode():
        allowed.append(c)
    else:
        stopped.append(c)
print('allowed:', ''.join(allowed))
print('stopped:', ''.join(stopped))
